title: BBK BBK Root Wayfinder result payload v1

anyOf.description: Baseline ID, revision, digest, lifecycle state, and durable path; null with a reason when no baseline exists yet.

baseline_ref.description: Baseline ID, revision, digest, lifecycle state, and durable path; null with a reason when no baseline exists yet.

anyOf.description: Exact ask-backed or otherwise authority-bound acceptance reference; null when not accepted.

acceptance_ref.description: Exact ask-backed or otherwise authority-bound acceptance reference; null when not accepted.

anyOf.description: Exact standing or explicit execution-authority reference and covered effect classes; null when not authorized.

execution_authority_ref.description: Exact standing or explicit execution-authority reference and covered effect classes; null when not authorized.

decision_refs.description: Accepted, proposed, reopened, and pending decision references with authority and freshness state.

planning_state.description: Current territory/interface map, completed and active frontier, blockers, residual fog, dependencies, and invalidation state.

fit_refs.description: Current SolutionOutcomeFit references or an explicit not-applicable disposition.

architecture_refs.description: Current architecture and material-interface references or an explicit not-applicable disposition.

work_graph_refs.description: Current capability, phase, work-unit, and worker-invocation references or an explicit not-ready disposition.

assurance_refs.description: Current verification, evidence, and independent-review design references or an explicit not-applicable disposition.

invalidated_or_superseded_refs.description: Planning objects invalidated, reopened, or superseded during this invocation.

residual_uncertainty.description: Explicit bounded uncertainty that remains after economic stopping.

outstanding_user_request_ids.description: Unresolved controller-mediated request IDs, if any.

blockers.description: Exact technical, authority, decision, capacity, or host-window blockers.

anyOf.description: The canonical next root for the harness-root controller, or null when no root transition is valid.

recommended_next_root.description: The canonical next root for the harness-root controller, or null when no root transition is valid.
